+import { pagePath } from '../../../../../../shared/paths.js'
+
+/** How many of a picker's addresses one page holds. */
+export const ADDRESSES_A_PAGE = 8
+
+const FIRST_PAGE = 1
+const MINIMUM_PAGES_TO_PAGINATE = 2
+const PAGES_EITHER_SIDE_OF_CURRENT = 1
+
+export const pageCountOf = (addressesFound) =>
+  Math.max(FIRST_PAGE, Math.ceil(addressesFound / ADDRESSES_A_PAGE))
+
+/** The page the picker serves for the one asked for: the last page when the
+ * request is past it. */
+export const servedPageOf = (requestedPage, addressesFound) =>
+  Math.min(requestedPage, pageCountOf(addressesFound))
+
+export const addressesBeforePage = (page) =>
+  (page - FIRST_PAGE) * ADDRESSES_A_PAGE
+
+export const addressesOnPage = (addresses, page) => {
+  const from = addressesBeforePage(page)
+  return addresses.slice(from, from + ADDRESSES_A_PAGE)
+}
+
+/** The results link for one page of a picker: the search term, the page and
+ * the row already ticked all travel in the query string, because paging is a
+ * link and not a submit. */
+export const resultsHref = (journeyId, slug, { query, page, selectedId }) => {
+  const params = new URLSearchParams()
+  if (query) {
+    params.set('q', query)
+  }
+  if (page > FIRST_PAGE) {
+    params.set('page', String(page))
+  }
+  if (selectedId) {
+    params.set('selected', selectedId)
+  }
+  return `${pagePath(journeyId, slug)}?${params.toString()}`
+}
+
+const numbersToShow = (page, totalPages) => {
+  const shown = [
+    FIRST_PAGE,
+    page - PAGES_EITHER_SIDE_OF_CURRENT,
+    page,
+    page + PAGES_EITHER_SIDE_OF_CURRENT,
+    totalPages
+  ].filter((number) => number >= FIRST_PAGE && number <= totalPages)
+  return [...new Set(shown)].sort((left, right) => left - right)
+}
+
+const itemsWithEllipses = (numbers, page, hrefFor) =>
+  numbers.flatMap((number, index, shown) => {
+    const item = { number, href: hrefFor(number), current: number === page }
+    const skipsPages = index > 0 && number - shown[index - 1] > 1
+    return skipsPages ? [{ ellipsis: true }, item] : [item]
+  })
+
+/** The `govukPagination` view model for a picker, or nothing when one page
+ * holds every address it offers. */
+export const paginationLinks = (
+  journeyId,
+  slug,
+  { query, page, totalPages, selectedId, labels }
+) => {
+  if (totalPages < MINIMUM_PAGES_TO_PAGINATE) {
+    return null
+  }
+  const hrefFor = (number) =>
+    resultsHref(journeyId, slug, { query, page: number, selectedId })
+  return {
+    previous:
+      page > FIRST_PAGE
+        ? { href: hrefFor(page - 1), text: labels.previous }
+        : undefined,
+    next:
+      page < totalPages
+        ? { href: hrefFor(page + 1), text: labels.next }
+        : undefined,
+    items: itemsWithEllipses(numbersToShow(page, totalPages), page, hrefFor)
+  }
+}

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+
+import { driveHandler } from '../../../../../../engine/test-support.js'
+import { useStubbedHighRiskPlantsJourney } from '../../test-support.js'
+import { copy as pickerCopy } from './copy/copy.en.js'
+import { ADDRESSES_A_PAGE, pageCountOf } from './pagination.js'
+
+const PAST_THE_LAST_PAGE = 40
+
+const pickerOn = async (get, seed, page) => {
+  const result = await driveHandler(get, {
+    seed: seed(),
+    query: { page: String(page) }
+  })
+  return result.view.context.picker
+}
+
+const pageNumbersOf = (wholeCount) =>
+  Array.from({ length: pageCountOf(wholeCount) }, (_, index) => index + 1)
+
+/**
+ * The paging cases every address picker's GET route shares.
+ *
+ * @param {object} picker
+ * @param {string} picker.pickerName - the page's name, for the describe
+ * @param {Function} picker.get - the page's GET handler
+ * @param {Function} picker.seed - gives the journey state the page opens on
+ * @param {number} picker.wholeCount - how many stub records this picker offers
+ */
+export const describePaging = ({ pickerName, get, seed, wholeCount }) => {
+  const onFirstPage = Math.min(wholeCount, ADDRESSES_A_PAGE)
+  const lastPage = pageCountOf(wholeCount)
+
+  describe(`GET ${pickerName} — the page of results it holds`, () => {
+    useStubbedHighRiskPlantsJourney()
+
+    it("Should open on a page of the role's addresses, counted against every one the role holds", async () => {
+      const picker = await pickerOn(get, seed, 1)
+
+      expect(picker.rows).toHaveLength(onFirstPage)
+      expect(picker.resultsCount).toBe(
+        pickerCopy.resultsCount(onFirstPage, wholeCount)
+      )
+    })
+
+    it('Should list every address for the role, and the role-less address, across its pages', async () => {
+      const pages = await Promise.all(
+        pageNumbersOf(wholeCount).map((page) => pickerOn(get, seed, page))
+      )
+      const ids = pages.flatMap((picker) => picker.rows.map((row) => row.id))
+
+      expect(ids).toHaveLength(wholeCount)
+      expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(wholeCount)
+    })
+
+    it('Should offer paging only where the role holds more addresses than a page', async () => {
+      const picker = await pickerOn(get, seed, 1)
+
+      if (wholeCount > ADDRESSES_A_PAGE) {
+        expect(picker.pagination.next.href).toContain('page=2')
+      } else {
+        expect(picker.pagination).toBeNull()
+      }
+    })
+
+    it('Should serve the last page, logged once, when the page asked for is past it', async () => {
+      const result = await driveHandler(get, {
+        seed: seed(),
+        query: { page: String(PAST_THE_LAST_PAGE) }
+      })
+
+      expect(result.view.context.picker.page).toBe(lastPage)
+      expect(result.logger.entries).toEqual([
+        {
+          level: 'info',
+          message:
+            'Address picker page is past the last page, serving the last page',
+          fields: expect.objectContaining({
+            requestedPage: PAST_THE_LAST_PAGE,
+            servedPage: lastPage
+          })
+        }
+      ])
+    })
+  })
+}
